question: What type of forests are found north and south of the equator between 40° and 60° where rainfall is high, between 500-1500 mm in a year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Temperate deciduous forests.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Temperate deciduous forests**

__
 
• **Temperate deciduous forests** are found between **40° and 60° north and south of the equator.**
 
• The** rainfall is high, between 500-1,500 mm **a year.
 
• The temperatures remain on average **above 0°C even in the winter.**
 
• The **summer temperatures **average between **25-20°C.**
 
• The winter is cooler, encouraging the trees to shed their leaves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Taiga forests**

 
• **Taiga** is generally referred to in **North America as a boreal forest or snow forest.**
 
• Taiga is the terrestrial biome with the **lowest annual average temperatures.**
 
• **The total yearly precipitation in the taiga biome is 10 - 30 inches (25 - 75 cm).**
 
• Snow may remain on the ground for as long as nine months in the northernmost extensions of the taiga biome.

**Coniferous forests**

 
• **Coniferous forests consist mostly of conifers**.
 
• The average temperature in **winter ranges from -40°C (-40°F) to 20°C (68°F).**
 
• The **average summer temperatures** are usually around **10°C (50°F).**
 
• **Precipitation** in coniferous forests varies from** 300 to 900 mm annually.**

**Mediterranean forests**

 
• **Mediterranean forests, **woodlands, and scrub is a biome defined by the World Wide Fund for Nature.
 
• **Precipitation totals ranging from 35 to 90 cm.**
 
• Mediterranean climate experiences **22.0 °C during summer** and **18 and −3 °C during winter.**
